title: Honest Interval Length for Resource-Calibrated Source-Tilted Interventions at a Fold
banked_reason: The advertised sharp original-data local optimization is not delivered: decision values, equality/gap and certified full-program optimization remain open; sound bracket and factor below1.17 graded incremental below field.
gap_reasons: The advertised sharp original-data local optimization is not delivered: this node leaves both decision values, their equality/gap, and the certified full-program optimization open, while the proved core supplies only a nonsharp lower/upper bracket and one fixed-rule upper bound; reframe the headline and positioning around that benchmark contribution rather than a sharp characterization.

The delivered result is an original-data fourth-root expected-length bracket with a simultaneous approximation guarantee below 1.17, rather than a determination of the sharp local values or exact simultaneous optimum. The converse covers arbitrary randomized procedures and the explicit upper construction preserves full-model honesty, but arbitrary-action limit extraction, sharp equality, and certified convergent decision optimization remain unresolved. The framing discloses these limitations and does not misstate the approximation factor as exact optimality. Testing-based expected-measure optimization is established substrate in [Evans, Hansen and Stark](https://www.stat.berkeley.edu/~stark/Preprints/617.pdf), so the contribution rests on the selected-branch geometry and its original-data honest transfer.
proof_attempt_summary: Derived a full-parent original-record fourth-root expected-length bracket, a moving-base all-procedure converse, and a certified simultaneous factor below 1.17; the math referee passed after six exact-source attestations and a paper-owned randomized likelihood-test bridge. The original sharp local values, equality-or-gap, convergent arbitrary-action decision program and exact simultaneous optimum remain open, so the delivered benchmark was graded incremental below the field floor and independently validated for downgraded stop. Formalization was never entered; there are no run-owned Lean results to promote.
tldr: Total resource calibration chooses the earlier feasible branch of a source-tilted causal intervention, and the maximum when the requested share is unattainable. The explicit interval family is honest; polynomial false-fallback tails, the local selected-root limit and the all-action original-record converse are proved. An original-record moving-base testing converse and a certified evaluation of the exact standard-rule risk improve the simultaneous precision factor to less than \(1.17\), hence less than \(1.18\). Sharp local values, their equality, and the exact simultaneous optimum remain open; no scalar experiment equivalence is asserted.
gap: de Aguas supplies the source-tilted intervention and smooth-curve inference, while Takatsu and Kuchibhotla supply honest optimization confidence sets. Neither inspected result determines the all-procedure expected-length optimum for total selected-root causal welfare at a fold. Song excludes square-root contact from its outer-transform classes. General confidence-size duality does not supply the original-data connected-action lift.
fill: The early theorem requires a center-free observable shape inversion with negligible length-one fallback tails. The main open question then characterizes both limit-order decision values and their computable certificates over the original experiment. A second common-action program determines the stipulated simultaneous factor, with a certified explicit baseline available without an oracle equality promise.
